name: nunch-skills-manager
description: Automatically refresh installed nunch-skills plugins and help set up their runtime dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Update plugins and check their dependencies
interface.longDescription: Check the configured nunch-skills Git marketplace once per day, update only plugins the user already installed, and help diagnose and install their runtime dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Check the nunch-skills update manager status.
